lines.en: label christmastwo17:
scene norikospresent1
Somehow, I wind up in front of Noriko.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我最后站到了 Noriko 面前。

lines.en: She holds a box that is both familiar and unfamiliar at the same time- which I’m sure sounds strange to you, but there’s no other way I can think of describing it.
lines.zh: 她手里拿着一个盒子，既熟悉又陌生——我知道这听起来很怪，但我想不出别的形容方式。

lines.en: I’m assuming this is that present she was telling me about a while back.
lines.zh: 我猜这就是她之前跟我说过的那份礼物。

lines.en: I still have no idea what to expect but, having grown to know this girl relatively well over the last several months, it’s safe to assume it’s likely something with some sort of...sentimental value.
lines.zh: 我依然完全不知道里面是什么，不过在最近几个月里，我已经相对了解这个女孩了，所以可以放心地假设，那大概是有某种……情感价值的东西。

lines.en: Despite her appearance, Noriko’s consistently been one of the most sentimental people I know.
lines.zh: 尽管她外表如此，Noriko 一直是我认识的最重感情的人之一。

lines.en: And I see no reason for her to break that pattern now- on a night that I’m sure she wishes she could have enjoyed with me in a different sort of way.
lines.zh: 而我看不出她有什么理由在今晚打破这个模式——在一个我敢肯定她希望能以另一种方式和我共度的夜晚。

lines.en: Perhaps in the future, if there even is one.
lines.zh: 也许在未来吧，如果我们还有未来的话。

lines.en: : Heeeeeey...
: I went up to the hotel room to find you, but Makoto told me you were busy with Miku, so...I figured I’d just wait around in the lobby until you showed up.
lines.zh: : 我上楼去酒店房间找你，可 Makoto 说你在忙 Miku 的事，所以……我就想着在大堂里等着，等到你出现。

lines.en: : Did she like her present?
lines.zh: : 她喜欢她的礼物吗？

lines.en: : Yes and no. It’s a little complicated.
lines.zh: : 喜欢也不喜欢。有点复杂。

lines.en: scene norikospresent2
: Yeah...I can...definitely relate to that.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我……完全能理解。

lines.en: : I take it that’s for me, then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，这是给我的？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Am I allowed to open it?
lines.zh: : 我可以打开吗？

lines.en: scene norikospresent3
: Huh? Yeah. Why wouldn’t you be?
lines.zh: : 哈？当然。为什么不能？

lines.en: : I’m just getting mixed signals between you and the box itself and I’m currently choosing sides.
lines.zh: : 我只是在你和这个盒子之间收到了矛盾的信号，而现在我正在选边站。

lines.en: : Well...I guess I should be pretty nervous then, huh?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我大概该相当紧张了，是吧？

lines.en: : Probably not. I can’t imagine myself ever choosing a box over you.
lines.zh: : 大概不用。我想象不出自己会为了一个盒子而放弃你。

lines.en: scene norikospresent4
: Yeah...we’ll see about that...
lines.zh: : 是啊……那可说不定……

lines.en: : Give it here, then. There’s no better place to break the rules than a hotel lobby and I am now determined to go against that box’s wishes.
lines.zh: : 那就给我吧。没有比酒店大堂更适合打破规矩的地方了，而我现在下定决心要违背这个盒子的意愿。

lines.en: : You know it wasn’t the {i}box{/i} who wrote “Do not open” on itself, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道“请勿打开”这几个字不是{i}盒子{/i}自己写的吧？

lines.en: : Also, can we maybe, like...not do this in here? I’d like to be somewhere a little more private since I’m probably going to cry.
lines.zh: : 还有，我们能不能，怎么说……换个地方做这个？我想找个私密一点的地方，因为我大概会哭。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I like the idea of whatever this present is making you cry, but if going somewhere else is what it takes for me to figure it out, sure.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己喜不喜欢“这份礼物会让你哭”这件事，但如果换个地方是我弄明白它的代价，那行。

lines.en: : I’m assuming Kirin told you about the boiler room, then?
lines.zh: : 我猜 Kirin 跟你提过锅炉房？

lines.en: scene norikospresent3
: Boiler room? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 锅炉房？你在说什么？

lines.en: : Oh. Nevermind. I just figured that’s what you meant with the whole “privacy” thing.
lines.zh: : 哦。没事。我只是以为你说的“私密”是指那个。

lines.en: : I’m mostly under the impression by now that Kirin just tells you everything immediately after it happens and-
lines.zh: : 我现在基本上的印象是，Kirin 会在事情发生后立刻告诉你一切，然后——

lines.en: : What were you and Kirin doing in-
lines.zh: : 你和 Kirin 在——

lines.en: scene norikospresent5
: Actually...no. That’s not important right now. I’ve only got a little while until I have to head back and...I kinda need you to see this before that.
lines.zh: : 算了……不。现在这不重要。我还有一点时间就得回去了，而且……我有点需要你在那之前看到这个。

lines.en: : You’re leaving already? Why?
lines.zh: : 你这么快就要走了？为什么？

lines.en: scene norikospresent6
: I don’t {i}want{/i} to leave.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}想{/i}走。

lines.en: : I just think I’ll have a harder time staying around after you see what’s inside the box.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，等你看到盒子里的东西之后，我会更难待在你身边。

lines.en: : Um...anyway...
: I’m pretty sure the roof is unlocked...and it’s not that cold out tonight, so we can probably do this up there?
lines.zh: : 我挺确定天台是没锁的……而且今晚外面也不算太冷，所以我们可以上去做这件事？

lines.en: : Stairs and boxes, my two favorite things.
lines.zh: : 爬楼梯和搬盒子，我最喜欢的两件事。

lines.en: : Lead the way. I’ll be right behind you.
lines.zh: : 带路吧。我就跟在你后面。

lines.en: : Not for long, you won’t.
lines.zh: : 不会跟太久的。

lines.en: scene black
I’m not exactly sure what Noriko means by that, but I follow her regardless.
lines.zh: 我不太确定 Noriko 这话是什么意思，但我还是跟着她走了。

lines.en: And, of course, she’s the type of person to take the stairs instead of the elevator.
lines.zh: 而她当然是那种宁可走楼梯也不坐电梯的人。

lines.en: So on top of having to ascend what feels like an ungodly amount of stories, I have to deal with the exhaustion of actually moving now as well.
lines.zh: 所以除了要爬上感觉多得离谱的楼层之外，我还得承受“真的在动”带来的疲惫。

lines.en: But if this is what it takes for her to cry in a contained environment rather than one that a classmate could pop into at any given moment, I guess it’s just something I have to deal with.
lines.zh: 但如果只有这样她才能在一个封闭的环境里哭，而不是在一个随时可能有同学闯进来的地方，那我想我也只能受着。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
As we open the door and step out onto the roof, I wonder how many more girls I’ll be forced to watch cry before the night comes to an end.
lines.zh: 当我们打开门走上天台时，我在想，在这个夜晚结束之前，我还要被迫看着多少个女孩哭。

lines.en: So much for Christmas being the most magical night of the year- if that’s even a thing people say.
lines.zh: 说什么圣诞节是一年中最神奇的夜晚——就算真有人这么说——看来也不过如此。

lines.en: But I guess that crying in itself is sort of magical in a way.
lines.zh: 不过我想，哭本身在某种意义上也挺神奇的。

lines.en: Not everyone is in tune enough with their feelings to do something like that. And many of the people who {i}are{/i} would just...rather not.
lines.zh: 并不是每个人都能如此贴近自己的情绪，做出这种事。而许多{i}能做到{/i}的人，只是……不愿意罢了。

lines.en: I’d say I hate it myself, but it’s been so long at this point that I don’t know if I can even attribute such a strong word to the idea of tears.
lines.zh: 我大概会说我讨厌哭，但已经过去这么久了，我不知道自己还能不能把这么强烈的词安在“眼泪”这个概念上。

lines.en: I will say with utmost certainty, though, that it’s a lot harder to hate something when you’re only experiencing it secondhand.
lines.zh: 不过我可以极其确定地说，当你只是间接体验某件事时，要讨厌它就难多了。

lines.en: The two of us approach the edge of the hotel and sit down on the concrete rooftop.
lines.zh: 我们俩走到酒店的边缘，在水泥屋顶上坐下。

lines.en: It’s cold. Much colder than the air itself.
lines.zh: 很冷。远比空气本身要冷。

lines.en: And despite being face to face with a girl prepared to be wounded all for the sake of tightening the rope wrapped around us-
lines.zh: 尽管我正面对着一个甘愿受伤、只为把缠绕在我们身上的绳子勒得更紧的女孩——

lines.en: All I can think of is wanting to go back inside.
lines.zh: 我满脑子想的却是想回到屋里去。

lines.en: scene norikospresent7
The box sits in my lap the same way she would when she was younger.
lines.zh: 盒子搁在我的腿上，就像她小时候会做的那样。

lines.en: That’s not a memory, just an educated guess based on all that I’ve heard from her.
lines.zh: 那不是记忆，只是根据我从她那里听来的一切做出的有根据的猜测。

lines.en: I’m sure she’s thinking something similar right now.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她现在也在想着类似的事。

lines.en: : So...how was the Christmas party without me being around? Any...I don’t know, quieter?
lines.zh: : 那么……我不在的时候圣诞派对怎么样？有没有……我不知道，安静一点？

lines.en: : Is this the part where you start stalling because you’re worried about how things are going to play out?
lines.zh: : 这就是你开始拖延的那个环节吗？因为你在担心事情会怎么发展？

lines.en: scene norikospresent8
: Ugh. I really should have tried rationing out all the times I’ve done that. I could seriously benefit from that tactic right now if you weren’t already familiar with my tricks.
lines.zh: : 呃。我真该把以前那些拖延的次数省着点用。如果你不是早就熟悉我这套把戏，我现在可是能好好利用这招的。

lines.en: : Guess you’re going to have to come up with a new method if you want some additional time in the future.
lines.zh: : 看来你以后要是想多争取点时间，得想个新招了。

lines.en: : Or not, since the world is just going to repeat itself soon anyway.
lines.zh: : 或者不用想，反正这世界很快就要重来一遍了。

lines.en: scene norikospresent9
: What, are we in some kind of movie right now?
lines.zh: : 什么，我们现在是在拍电影之类的吗？

lines.en: : You gonna tell me that the only reason you don’t remember me is because you went all Eternal Sunshine on yourself?
lines.zh: : 你该不会要告诉我，你不记得我的唯一原因是你给自己来了出《暖暖内含光》吧？

lines.en: : I have no idea what that is.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么。

lines.en: : Well, we should watch it together if you still want to be around me after tonight.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果今晚之后你还想待在我身边，我们应该一起看。

lines.en: : Noriko, I’m not going to find the severed head of someone I care about inside of this box, am I? Because you seem really worried that whatever is in here is going to make me...dislike you or something.
lines.zh: : Noriko，我打开这个盒子不会看到某个我在乎的人的断头吧？因为你看起来真的很担心里面的东西会让我……讨厌你之类的。

lines.en: : What if it was a severed head of someone you {i}didn’t{/i} like? Then what?
lines.zh: : 如果是你{i}不{/i}喜欢的人的断头呢？那怎么办？

lines.en: : You’re stalling again and I’m not falling for it.
lines.zh: : 你又在拖延了，我不会上当的。

lines.en: : You can’t fault me for trying.
lines.zh: : 你不能怪我试试看吧。

lines.en: : Can I open this now, then? Or do you know some spiritual hack where opening boxes facing west is somehow a good luck charm?
lines.zh: : 那我现在可以打开了吗？还是说你知道什么玄学偏方，比如朝西开箱能带来好运？

lines.en: : You can open it.
lines.zh: : 你可以打开了。

lines.en: : You’ve waited long enough.
lines.zh: : 你已经等得够久了。

lines.en: scene norikospresent10
I peel back the tape covering the box and place it on the concrete.
lines.zh: 我撕开盒子上的胶带，把它放在水泥地上。

lines.en: The wind sweeps it away and carries it off the ledge immediately.
lines.zh: 风立刻把它卷走，吹下了屋檐。

lines.en: There’s some sort of metaphor or symbolism to be gleaned from that, but I can’t be bothered to decode it right now.
lines.zh: 这里面大概能解读出什么隐喻或象征，但我现在没心情去解码。

lines.en: There’s nothing lavish or exciting inside of the box-
lines.zh: 盒子里没有什么奢华或令人兴奋的东西——

lines.en: Just a stack of what appear to be organized papers with neat, half-cursive handwriting covering them.
lines.zh: 只有一叠看起来整理得整整齐齐的纸，上面写满了一半连笔的工整字迹。

lines.en: I’m assuming that whatever the {i}present{/i} is lies within these pages.
lines.zh: 我猜，那份{i}礼物{/i}就藏在这些纸页里。

lines.en: scene norikospresent11
: What is this?
lines.zh: : 这是什么？

lines.en: scene norikospresent12
: Your past.
lines.zh: : 你的过去。

lines.en: : Or a little piece of it at least.
lines.zh: : 或者说，至少是其中的一小块。

lines.en: : We’d need a lot more boxes to pack up our entire history.
lines.zh: : 要把我们的整段历史装起来，得用上多得多的盒子。

lines.en: : Did you write these?
lines.zh: : 这些是你写的？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: scene nikil1
: Nee-chan wrote all of these for you after you disappeared.
lines.zh: : 你消失之后，Nee-chan 为你写了所有这些。

lines.en: : There were hundreds of them.
lines.zh: : 有好几百封。

lines.en: : She must have been writing one every single day for...I don’t even know how long.
lines.zh: : 她大概是每天都写一封，写了……我甚至不知道多久。

lines.en: : But obviously, she had no idea where to send them.
lines.zh: : 但显然，她完全不知道该寄到哪里。

lines.en: scene nikil2
: Not at first, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少一开始不知道。

lines.en: : And even when you started seeing me again, it’s not like I could have just...delivered these to you.
lines.zh: : 而且就算后来你又开始见我了，我也不可能就这么……把这些交给你。

lines.en: : Like...I had no idea they even existed until I was going through her closet the other day.
lines.zh: : 就像……我前几天翻她衣柜的时候才发现它们存在。

lines.en: : And if Nee-chan knew in the beginning that I was getting to spend time with you but not her, it would have broken her even more.
lines.zh: : 如果 Nee-chan 一开始就知道我能和你相处而她不能，那会把她伤得更深。

lines.en: scene nikil3
: She loved you...so, so, so, so much.
lines.zh: : 她爱你……那么、那么、那么、那么深。

lines.en: : More than I ever did. More than I ever {i}could.{/i}
lines.zh: : 比我爱得深。比我{i}可能{/i}爱得深。

lines.en: : {i}How can I compete with that, Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我拿什么跟那个比，老师？{/i}

lines.en: : I spent so much time psyching myself up and trying to win your affection like it was some sort of...{i}contest{/i} that I lost sight of how I started with the biggest handicap of all.
lines.zh: : 我花了那么多时间给自己打气，试图赢得你的心，好像那是什么……{i}比赛{/i}，结果我看不见自己一开始就背负着最大的劣势。

lines.en: : I’ve been second place forever. In everything.
lines.zh: : 我永远都是第二名。在一切事情上。

lines.en: : And if it wasn’t with Nee-chan, it was with Maya.
lines.zh: : 如果不是输给 Nee-chan，就是输给 Maya。

lines.en: scene nikil4
: I’m just the...younger, spunkier version of the girl you used to love. And she’s still the same person she’s always been. So like...what's the point of {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我只是你曾经爱过的那个女孩的……更年轻、更活泼的版本。而她还是她一直以来的那个人。所以，怎么说……{i}我{/i}存在的意义是什么？

lines.en: : Even if I’ve changed...even if the...{i}perfect{/i} girl I dreamt up for you is completely to your liking...I still don’t have what she did.
lines.zh: : 就算我变了……就算我为你幻想出来的那个……{i}完美{/i}女孩完全合你心意……我还是没有她拥有的东西。

lines.en: : I don’t have that history.
lines.zh: : 我没有那段历史。

lines.en: : The...backlog of emotions and kisses and whatever other shit you guys did to each other before I even understood grammar.
lines.zh: : 那些积压的情绪、那些吻，还有在我还不懂语法之前你们对彼此做过的随便什么别的事。

lines.en: : I couldn’t keep hiding this from you.
lines.zh: : 我没法再对你藏着这个了。

lines.en: scene nikil5
: I mean...I {i}could{/i} have kept hiding it from you. And it probably would have made my chances a million times better...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我{i}本来可以{/i}一直藏着。而且那样我的机会大概会好上一百万倍……

lines.en: : But that wouldn’t be fair. To you...or Nee-chan...or even me in a sort of really roundabout way that I can probably justify if you give me enough time.
lines.zh: : 但那不公平。对你、对 Nee-chan、甚至对我自己——以一种大概只要你给我足够时间我就能自圆其说的、非常迂回的方式。

lines.en: : So...yeah.
lines.zh: : 所以……嗯。

lines.en: : If you can’t remember the past, I’ll bring the past to you.
lines.zh: : 如果你记不起过去，那我就把过去带到你面前。

lines.en: : Even if it’s not my place to do that.
lines.zh: : 就算这不该由我来做。

lines.en: : Even if I have to steal embarrassing stuff out of my older sister’s closet because, at least until today, she was too stubborn to even think about telling you.
lines.zh: : 就算我得从我姐姐的衣柜里偷出这些让人难为情的东西——因为至少在今天之前，她固执得连想都没想过要告诉你。

lines.en: scene norikospresent13
: That wasn’t the last one, you know.
lines.zh: : 你知道，那不是最后一封。

lines.en: : There were tons more after that.
lines.zh: : 在那之后还有很多很多。

lines.en: : Even when my parents were getting on her case about how it was becoming an unhealthy obsession...she never stopped.
lines.zh: : 就算我爸妈开始数落她，说这已经变成了一种不健康的执念……她也从没停下过。

lines.en: : She never stopped loving you.
lines.zh: : 她从来没有停止爱你。

lines.en: : And she never will.
lines.zh: : 而她永远不会。

lines.en: scene norikospresent14
: Ugh. Right on cue. I told you I was going to cry.
lines.zh: : 呃。说曹操曹操到。我说过我会哭的。

lines.en: : If your memories really are gone, I’m sure you might believe that these could just be fake or something...
lines.zh: : 如果你的记忆真的没了，我猜你可能会觉得这些都可能是假的什么的……

lines.en: : And I have no way of proving they’re not.
lines.zh: : 而我也没办法证明它们不是。

lines.en: : But, no matter what you choose to believe or...what you decide to do from here on out...I think you should at least consider Nee-chan’s feelings.
lines.zh: : 但是，无论你选择相信什么，或者……从今往后决定怎么做……我觉得你至少该考虑一下 Nee-chan 的感受。

lines.en: : Mine too, if you can...but...
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，也考虑一下我的……不过……

lines.en: : Alas...
: Second place forever...
lines.zh: : 永远的第二名……

lines.en: scene norikospresent15
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: scene norikospresent18
: Shouldn’t we be watching Christmas movies right now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在不是该在看圣诞电影吗？

lines.en: : It feels kind of weird to be watching anime when we told your parents we were going to do our {i}own{/i} Christmas stuff instead of what they wanted to do.
lines.zh: : 我们跟爸妈说了要过{i}自己{/i}的圣诞节、不做他们想做的事，结果却在看动画，感觉有点怪。

lines.en: : Are you kidding? Why would we watch something that lame when the newest episode of Gunfighter Z: Machine War Paradox Chronicles comes out tonight?
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑吧？Gunfighter Z: Machine War Paradox Chronicles 的最新一集今晚播出，我们干嘛要看那种无聊的东西？

lines.en: : Why are anime titles always so long? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 为什么动画的标题总是这么长？我不懂。

lines.en: scene norikospresent19
: Well, you’re more than welcome to go back downstairs and play with Noriko instead if you want. Since you’re too much of a loser to watch giant robots blow up other giant robots, I mean.
lines.zh: : 那你要是这么想，尽可以下楼去和 Noriko 玩啊。既然你没劲到看不了巨大机器人互殴。

lines.en: : No thanks. She keeps trying to sit on my lap and it’s weird.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢了。她老是想坐我腿上，怪怪的。

lines.en: scene norikospresent20
: I know, right?! She thinks you’re like, her {i}actual{/i} big brother or something. And my parents see no problem with it at all.
lines.zh: : 就是说啊？！她好像把你当成，怎么说，她{i}真正的{/i}哥哥之类的。而我爸妈居然觉得完全没问题。

lines.en: : I don’t think there’s a {i}problem{/i} with it, I’d just rather hang out with you.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这有什么{i}问题{/i}，我只是更想和你待在一起。

lines.en: scene norikospresent21
: W-Well of course you’d rather hang out with me than some kid. That’s barely even a compliment.
lines.zh: : 那、那你当然是宁愿和我待着，也不愿和某个小孩待着。这根本算不上夸奖。

lines.en: : Then why are you blushing so much?
lines.zh: : 那你脸红成这样是为什么？

lines.en: scene norikospresent22
: I...I’m not blushing! It’s just hot in my stupid room because my parents won’t turn the stupid heat off!
lines.zh: : 我……我才没脸红！是我这破房间太热了，我爸妈死活不肯把那破暖气关掉！

lines.en: : Don’t you have a thermostat in here? Just turn it down yourself if you’re hot.
lines.zh: : 你房间里没有恒温器吗？热就自己调低啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...I don’t know how to use it...
lines.zh: : 有是有，可是……我不知道怎么用……

lines.en: : You’re completely helpless, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真是完全生活不能自理啊，是吧？

lines.en: : If you’re so smart, why don’t you do it?!
lines.zh: : 你这么聪明，你怎么不来调？！

lines.en: : Because you’re not actually hot. You’re just saying that.
lines.zh: : 因为你根本不热。你只是嘴上说说。

lines.en: : Why would I lie?! Also, shut up! Gunfighter is about to come on!
lines.zh: : 我为什么要撒谎？！还有，闭嘴！Gunfighter 要开播了！

lines.en: scene norikospresent23
: I’ll just turn the heat down myself.
lines.zh: : 我自己把暖气调低就行了。

lines.en: : Even if your parents would get mad at {i}you{/i} for doing it, they-
lines.zh: : 就算{i}你{/i}爸妈会为此生你的气，他们——

lines.en: scene norikospresent24
: [[REDACTED]? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : [已编辑]？怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没事。

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我很好。

lines.en: : I’m actually feeling a little cold, though...so I don’t think I’m going to turn the heat down after all.
lines.zh: : 不过我其实觉得有点冷……所以我想我还是不调低暖气了。

lines.en: : Cold? Oooooh...{i}maybe there’s a ghost in the room?{/i}
lines.zh: : 冷？哦—————哦……{i}说不定房间里有鬼？{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe...
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许吧……

lines.en: : [[REDACTED], no. I was obviously kidding. There’s no such thing as ghosts. They’re-
lines.zh: : [已编辑]，不。我显然是在开玩笑。世上没有鬼这种东西。它们——

lines.en: : {i}You’re such a good boy.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真是个好男孩。{/i}

lines.en: scene norikospresent25
: {i}It’s no wonder I fell in love with you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}难怪我爱上了你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You try so hard to keep this side of you away from everyone that when it finally comes out, you just seem a million times cuter.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你那么努力地把这一面的自己藏起来不让任何人看到，所以当它终于露出来的时候，你就显得可爱了一百万倍。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You know, the best part about being in second place is that even if I don’t win, I always have a really clear view of the goal.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道吗，当第二名最好的地方在于，就算我赢不了，我也总能清清楚楚地看见终点。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’ll keep running, Sensei. Forever and ever. Even when I know I can’t win.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我会一直跑下去，老师。永远，永远。哪怕我知道自己赢不了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Even when my legs give out.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哪怕我的腿跑断了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And, who knows? Maybe the next obstacle I put down will wind up knocking someone else over instead of me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且，谁知道呢？也许我放下的下一个障碍物，会绊倒别人而不是我。{/i}

lines.en: scene norikospresent26
: Merry Christmas.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐。

lines.en: : Maybe next year I’ll get you a present that doesn’t immediately make me cry.
lines.zh: : 也许明年我能送你一份不会让我当场哭出来的礼物。

lines.en: : I remembered something...
lines.zh: : 我想起了一些事……

lines.en: : Was it nice?
lines.zh: : 是美好的事吗？

lines.en: : I bet it was.
lines.zh: : 我打赌是的。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
My phone suddenly goes off in my pocket.
lines.zh: 我口袋里的手机突然响了。

lines.en: : Looks like my time here is up...
lines.zh: : 看来我在这儿的时间到了……

lines.en: : You better answer that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你最好接一下，老师。

lines.en: : I bet it’s someone really important.
lines.zh: : 我打赌是个非常重要的人。

lines.en: Noriko leaves the roof and I struggle to regain enough control of my hands to reach for my phone.
lines.zh: Noriko 离开了天台，而我艰难地重新夺回双手的控制权，去够我的手机。

lines.en: I look down at one of the letters and notice that I’ve been gripping it so tightly that it’s begun to crinkle and tear.
lines.zh: 我低头看向其中一封信，发现自己把它攥得那么紧，纸已经开始起皱、撕裂。

lines.en: I can still see it- the vision of an old bedroom.
lines.zh: 我依然看得见——那间旧卧室的画面。

lines.en: The scent of baked goods leaking in through the crack under the door and the feeling of my dick going numb from having to lie on it for so long to conceal an erection.
lines.zh: 烘焙点心的香气从门缝里渗进来，还有我为了掩饰勃起而趴了太久、鸡巴麻掉的感觉。

lines.en: I can still imagine her face and the hue of her cheeks when I called her out for blushing.
lines.zh: 我依然能想象出她的脸，以及我指出她在脸红时她双颊的色泽。

lines.en: But why {i}that{/i} night?
lines.zh: 可为什么是{i}那个{/i}夜晚？

lines.en: Why would I recall something so small and insignificant when I’m sure there were thousands of other memories I made with her that were ten times bigger?
lines.zh: 我敢肯定我和她之间有成千上万个比这重要十倍的回忆，为什么我偏偏想起这么微不足道的小事？

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: I don’t know anything other than the fact that it’s true now. That Niki is who she says she is.
lines.zh: 我什么都不知道，只知道现在这是真的了。Niki 就是她所说的那个人。

lines.en: And so is Noriko, even if her new fascination is taking over the role of a martyr in an effort to get me back together with someone who she both loves and loathes all at once.
lines.zh: Noriko 也是，哪怕她新的执念正在扮演一个殉道者的角色，只为让我和某个她既爱又恨的人重归于好。

lines.en: My phone goes off again.
lines.zh: 我的手机又响了。

lines.en: I place the letter back inside of the box, closing it tightly and subconsciously reaching for the tape that had been carried off the ledge just moments ago.
lines.zh: 我把信放回盒子里，紧紧合上，下意识地去够刚才被吹下屋檐的胶带。

lines.en: Of course, I grasp nothing but the air itself.
lines.zh: 当然，我抓到的只有空气本身。

lines.en: But then-
lines.zh: 但接着——

lines.en: I recover enough control to gaze into a small, electric rectangle and see who the cause of these beeps has been.
lines.zh: 我恢复足够的控制力，望向那块小小的电子长方形，看看这些提示音到底是谁发来的。

lines.en: : {i}Come downstairs right now. I know you’re up there. I need to talk to you. It’s important. Please.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}马上下来。我知道你在上面。我需要和你谈谈。很重要。求你了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’ll be in front of your hotel. Noriko gave me the address. And come alone. Don’t bring her. Please.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我会在你住的酒店门前。Noriko 给了我地址。一个人来。别带她。求你了。{/i}
